name: @w6w-apps/nationbuilder
description: Manage NationBuilder people, lists, events, donations and tags for campaigns, nonprofits and advocacy groups.

w6w.longDescription:
NationBuilder is a CRM and organizing platform for campaigns, nonprofits and advocacy groups, built around one shared record of every person a nation has ever touched — a "signup" in NationBuilder's own vocabulary, exposed here as a person. This app puts the daily loop of running a nation behind a workflow: create, look up, update and delete people; group them into lists and move people on and off a list in bulk; tag and untag them; and log a contact attempt (a canvass call, a door knock, a text) against a person's record.

Events round out the organizing side — creating and listing events and RSVPing a person to one — and donations cover the fundraising side, creating and listing gifts against a person's record. Custom fields can be listed so a workflow can populate a nation's own configured fields correctly instead of guessing at what has been set up.

Every nation runs on its own `{slug}.nationbuilder.com` subdomain, so the nation is chosen at connect time, not baked into the app, and both of NationBuilder's own documented ways in are offered: the public OAuth 2.0 flow (the only supported way to run against production, but gated behind either NationBuilder's Certified Developer program or an Enterprise/Network-plan nation) and a short-lived personal API token from the control panel's Developer settings, for a quick connection to a nation whose owner already has one.

Deliberately out of scope: NationBuilder's fundraising pages, petitions, surveys, path/automation builders, imports, voter-file fields, memberships, precincts, ballots and elections, and its own website/CMS surfaces. Each is its own large surface, and none of it is the daily loop of managing people, lists, events, donations and tags a workflow actually touches.
